summary: Added a direct restart-sentinel delivery path in src/gateway/server-restart-sentinel.ts that uses createOutboundSendDeps + runMessageAction for kind='restart' messages and returns on success, while preserving agentCommand as fallback (including fallback when direct send throws) for non-restart/complex sentinels. Imported GATEWAY client constants and wired gateway metadata for outbound sends. Added src/gateway/server-restart-sentinel.test.ts with coverage for: (1) restart sentinels use runMessageAction and skip agentCommand, (2) config-apply sentinels still use agentCommand, and (3) restart direct-send failure falls back to agentCommand. Verified with: pnpm vitest run src/gateway/server-restart-sentinel.test.ts, pnpm vitest run src/gateway/server-restart-sentinel, pnpm build, pnpm lint. Service restart validation command was not executed because restart operations are explicitly disallowed during this goal run.
